Codes, instruments, and treatments remain modern and are anachronistic.

code.originalText: Seven-month review: blood pressure, heart failure status, metabolic panel, stroke prevention and plans for the year

text.paragraph: Seven-month review: blood pressure, heart failure and screening results. [S]

Ms. Hurston returns five weeks after her annual wellness visit. She is substitute teaching two or three days a week and finishing a chapter of her new book. She walks to the bus without stopping and has had no lightheadedness, chest pain or swelling. Her home blood pressure average is 122/74. Her drug plan with Extra Help now supplies all five medicines in 90-day fills. Her screening results: the stool test (FIT) was negative, the mammogram was normal, the hepatitis C antibody was negative, and the bone density scan showed osteopenia (lowest T-score -1.6 at the femoral neck) with a ten-year risk of hip fracture below the level at which medicine is advised. The optometrist found mild hypertensive changes in the retinas without bleeding or swelling. She would like her zoster and Tdap vaccines today. [S]
